description.value: A pharmaco-fMRI study of acute escitalopram effects on neural responses during virtual violent actions in healthy male participants.

spans.text: We investigated effects of a single-dose selective 5-HT reuptake inhibitor (escitalopram) on emotion regulation during virtual violence.

description.value: Functional EPI data were preprocessed in BrainVoyager QX 2.4 using slice-scan time correction, 4-mm FWHM spatial smoothing, 3D motion correction aligned to the first volume of the first session with sinc interpolation, and high-pass filtering with linear trend removal. The first five images of each session were discarded, and the data were coregistered to the anatomical image and transformed into Talairach space for event-related fMRI analysis.
